skill.name: mp-grilling
skill.description: Use when you want to stress-test a plan or design before building — a relentless one-question-at-a-time interview that resolves every decision to a shared understanding.
whenToUse: Stress-testing a plan or design before you start building
You want every branch of the design tree walked and its decisions resolved
You keep hand-waving details and want them forced into the open

keyConcepts.explanation: Interview the user about every aspect of the plan until you reach a shared understanding, walking down each branch of the design tree and resolving dependencies between decisions one by one.
Ask questions one at a time and wait for feedback on each before continuing. Asking multiple questions at once is bewildering.
For each question, provide your recommended answer — don't just ask, take a position the user can react to.
If a fact can be found by exploring the codebase, look it up rather than asking. The decisions, though, are the user's — put each one to them and wait for their answer.

gotchas: Never ask multiple questions at once — it's bewildering; strictly one at a time
Don't ask the user for facts you can find in the codebase yourself
Do not enact the plan until the user confirms a shared understanding is reached
Always attach your recommended answer to each question
